question: If C₁, C₂ be the centres of two circles and r₁, r₂ be the respective radii such that the distance between the centres is equal to the sum of the radii of the two circles, find the number of common tangents.
solution:
Given:

C1, C2 be the centres of two circles and r1, r2 be the respective radii such that the distance between the centres is equal to the sum of the radii of the two circles

Calculation:

Distance between two centres C1 and C2, d = r1 + r2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7863c013c2defbdcd461a984e67d070c3644a94cad9aee66951e921eba4c9984.png] 

Since d = r1 + r2, two circles will touch each other externally.

​According to the figure, the number of common tangents = 3

**∴ The number of common tangents is 3.**
